# Verify

> Verify (@revyl/verify) is an open-source TypeScript library for Revyl. It opens cloud browsers and iOS/Android devices for agent instruction/validation steps, or Mac computers for commands, files, processes, and screenshots. Linux is typed but cannot be opened yet. Call it from a plain script, coding agent, CI, or any test runner. It has no test runner of its own.

## Docs

- [Getting started](getting-started.md): install, authenticate, init, run a script
- [API](api.md): open(), agent steps, screenshot(), exec(), file/process methods, close()
- [Configuration](configuration.md): verify.config.ts targets, environment variables, the init and whoami commands
- [Web](web.md): Revyl web sessions, URLs and builds, sign-in, steps on web and Revyl staging
- [Mobile](mobile.md): iOS and Android devices and installing apps
- [Computers](computers.md): Mac commands, files, process handles, screenshots, staging availability, and cleanup
- [Linux contract](linux-computers-contract.md): deferred implementation, requests/responses, readiness, errors, and assumptions to confirm
- [CI and test runners](ci.md): GitHub Actions, node:test, Vitest, Jest, Playwright Test
- [Errors](errors.md): every error code and what to do about it
- [For coding agents](agents.md): the workflow and rules for agents using Verify
